_comment: Topic definitions. Every topic maps to fields Kalshi publishes, so the mapping is checkable rather than keyword guesswork. Verified references: framework (category/categories/tags on a series, event carries `category`) https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/terms ; authoritative category->tag map https://docs.kalshi.com/api-reference/search/get-tags-for-series-categories ; series list with category filter https://docs.kalshi.com/api-reference/market/get-series-list ; events expose category https://docs.kalshi.com/api-reference/events/get-events . Rule shape: a series joins a topic if ANY rule matches; inside one rule all present conditions must match (AND).

gas.label: Gas prices
gas.blurb: Retail gasoline price contracts. Kalshi tags these series "Oil and energy" (Economics) and "Oil & Gas" (Commodities).
gas.basis: Kalshi series tags Oil and energy / Oil & Gas (official tags_by_categories map)
gas.note: AAA is the settlement source Kalshi names for these series; EIA is listed as an independent public reference for retail prices.

elections.label: Elections
elections.blurb: Kalshi's own "Elections" category: US and international election, nomination and control markets.

culture.label: Culture
culture.blurb: Kalshi's "Culture" category plus the Entertainment and Social categories, where awards, music, TV, movies and celebrity markets are actually listed.

crypto.label: Crypto
crypto.blurb: Kalshi's own "Crypto" category: BTC, ETH, SOL and other price or threshold markets.

golf.label: Golf
golf.blurb: Sports series that Kalshi tags "Golf": PGA, LPGA and LIV tournament and leader markets.

exclude_note: Exchange-manufactured combination products are excluded from rankings: https://docs.kalshi.com/api-reference/events/get-multivariate-events
